label: CNIC validator and info
description: Validate Pakistani CNIC numbers and read the province and gender they encode.

label: Passport and vehicle plates
description: Check the shape of a Pakistani passport number, and split a vehicle registration plate into series, number and year.

label: Form inputs
description: Fields that format as you type and only show an error when the value can no longer become valid. Built with the pakdatakit-react components.

label: Phone analyser
description: Validate Pakistani mobile numbers, format to E.164, and detect the issuing network.

label: Landlines and UAN numbers
description: Identify mobile, landline, UAN, toll-free and premium-rate numbers, with the area code and city for landlines and UANs.

label: WhatsApp links
description: Generate wa.me click-to-chat links for Pakistani mobile numbers, with an optional pre-filled message, and see the code for it.

label: Cities and districts
description: Look up provinces, search cities and districts, or list districts by province.

label: Postal codes
description: Look up postal codes by city, find cities by code, or search postal entries.

label: Post offices and tehsils
description: Every delivery post office in Pakistan Post's directory (about 2,560, including villages), and the tehsils of each district from the 2023 census.

label: Address parser
description: Parse free-form Pakistani addresses into structured components and format them back.

label: COD checks
description: Spot cash-on-delivery orders a rider will struggle to deliver: score how complete an address is, and flag phone numbers a courier cannot use.

label: Courier cities (experimental)
description: Match the short forms, old names and Urdu spellings customers type to the city list, and map a courier's own status to one vocabulary. No courier API is called.

label: Currency and amounts in words
description: Format Pakistani Rupee amounts with lakh/crore conventions and write them in words for cheques, in English and Urdu.

label: IBAN validator
description: Validate Pakistani IBANs with the mod-97 checksum and see which bank issued them, what kind of bank it is and whether it still exists.

label: Raast QR codes
description: Create Raast payment QR codes, and check any Pakistani payment QR for tampering, expiry or a bad IBAN before paying.

label: Electricity and gas bills
description: Check and format electricity bill references (DISCO reference numbers and customer IDs, K-Electric accounts) and SNGPL or SSGC gas consumer numbers.

label: NTN and STRN
description: Check the format of FBR National Tax Numbers and Sales Tax Registration Numbers.

label: Sales tax
description: Try sales tax in your browser: the rate for goods (FBR) or services in each province on any date since July 2019, and the tax on an amount.

label: Income tax on salary
description: Income tax on salary from the salaried rate table of the Income Tax Ordinance 2001, for tax years 2020 to 2027, computed exactly in whole paisa.

label: FBR invoice validator
description: Check an FBR Digital Invoicing invoice offline against PRAL's DI API specification v1.12, with FBR's own error codes. Nothing is sent to FBR.

label: Text utilities
description: Normalize text, Roman Urdu spellings, and convert between English and Urdu digits.

label: Urdu slugs
description: URL slugs that keep Urdu letters instead of dropping them, with the option to keep only Latin or only Urdu words.

label: Hijri calendar
description: Convert Gregorian dates to Hijri, format Islamic dates, and check for Ramadan.

label: Public holidays
description: Pakistan's federal public holidays, using the Eid, Ashura and Milad dates actually observed after moon sighting.

label: Mock data (faker)
description: Realistic Pakistani test data that fits together: the CNIC matches the province and gender, and the city, postal code, area code and bank agree.
